summary: Ran prettier, svelte-check, and vitest suites across the app and agent-server packages. Formatting and type checks passed, but one App.test.ts case ('gives a run of agent messages one header instead of one each') failed because findByText could not locate 'connected and ready for commands' in the rendered DOM.
errors: App.test.ts > application shell > 'gives a run of agent messages one header instead of one each' failed with TestingLibraryElementError: unable to find text '/connected and ready for commands/'. Investigation traced the text to FakeAgentClient.ts streaming deltas; the cause was not conclusively determined in this segment.
